name: Spinner
looksLike: small wheel turning beside loading text
definition: A looping loading indicator that shows work is ongoing without measuring how much has finished.
whenToUse: Loading when the remaining time is unknown

notConfusedWith.difference: Can show measurable completion; a spinner gives no percentage.

prompts.short: Add a spinner with loading text and respect reduced-motion preferences.
prompts.detailed: Show a spinner and meaningful status text while work is pending. Hide the decorative ring from assistive technology, announce the status politely, and disable its rotation when reduced motion is requested. Remove it when work completes and communicate the result.

reactTailwind: // Show while loading; replace the status text when the task finishes.
<span aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 shrink-0 rounded-full border-2 border-current border-r-transparent motion-safe:animate-spin" />

a11yNotes: Include meaningful loading text in a polite status region
Hide decorative motion from screen readers
Respect reduced motion and communicate completion
